job.label: Proposal To Alter A Local Taxation List
job.description: Job for proposing alterations to local taxation lists. | This is an example of a Bridge API payload instance. The premise concerns a person that has recently become the taxpayer of a dwelling on Cambrian Street, Aberystwyth in Wales who, after receiving their council tax bill, is of the opinion that the valuation band shown for the dwelling is inapplicable. The person formally asserts that the valuation band should always have been C instead of D, and proposes that the list be altered accordingly; Whereupon a revised bill will be issued by the billing authority in whose list the dwelling is currently shown and any overpayments refunded. The information transported across the business systems perimeter by Bridge must ultimately enable the business’s internal systems to determine if the proposal has been validly made.

class.meaning: Proposal to alter a council tax valuation list compiled for a billing authority in Wales (LGFA92s24(5)=>SI290-93Reg6)

premises.text:
The list is inaccurate because the listing officer has determined as applicable to the dwelling a valuation band
other than that which should have been determined as so applicable.

statements.text: The reason for believing the valuation band is not applicable is that other dwellings in my street like mine are in a different band.

alterations: The valuation band should be amended to band C with effect from the 1st April 2005.
